title: asset_balance_changes are built from a failed transaction's diagnostic events, so a failed Soroban transaction gets rows for rolled-back transfers
severity_basis: Wrong value in a secondary field: the operation details' asset_balance_changes list movements of a failed transaction that the ledger rolled back; no balance column is changed and the transaction is exported as failed. Seen by the linter at the pinned commit and confirmed by reading the source; the issue is already open upstream.

entries.expected: balance-change rows are built from diagnostic events only for a successful transaction
entries.observed: XDR405 (error) at internal/transform/operation.go:1889 (transactionOperationWrapper.parseAssetBalanceChangesFromContractEvents) and :1924 (parseAssetBalanceChangesFromContractEvents): LedgerTransaction.GetDiagnosticEvents() feeds the asset_balance_changes rows with no check that the transaction succeeded, here or in any caller (make lint-stellar-etl). filterEvents (:1865) keeps only events with InSuccessfulContractCall, which is the contract call's outcome, not the transaction's. The corpus entry is a failed transaction (resource_limit_exceeded) whose diagnostic events hold Stellar Asset Contract transfers marked in_successful_contract_call; no replay of it against stellar-etl is recorded.

evidence.pre_fix: make lint-stellar-etl (xdrlint built with the Go toolchain stellar-etl requires, shipped default profile) at v2.8.35 (7e3fc9af): XDR405, severity error, at the two GetDiagnosticEvents() calls in internal/transform/operation.go, suppressed with this record as its finding.
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-46: a failed transaction's operations have no effect on the ledger outside the fee; diagnostic events are debugging output that still lists calls which returned before the transaction failed, so in_successful_contract_call does not say the movement happened (lint/docs/XDR405.md).

reproduction.by: kit maintainer (linter re-run and source reading at the pinned commit)
reproduction.method: make lint-stellar-etl OFFLINE=1 at the pinned commit: both reports again at the recorded lines; the two functions and filterEvents read again at 7e3fc9af: neither function nor any caller checks LedgerTransaction.Successful().

evidence_added.reason: The issue, opened by a stellar-etl maintainer, already describes asset_balance_changes being populated for failed Soroban transactions; the linter report points at the same two functions and adds nothing the issue lacks.

history.note: From the stellar-etl linter run at the pinned commit (XDR405 at operation.go:1889 and :1924); listed as pending finding review.
Sites verified at 7e3fc9af; the open upstream item already records this defect. Suppressed at the pinned commit with this record as its finding; the two pending entries removed.
